items.title: Baroque Medallion DXF Panel with Ornate Scroll Filigree
items.description: A large central rosette blooms outward into swirling acanthus-style scrollwork, framed top and bottom by mirrored damask borders. The dramatic, richly layered filigree makes a striking statement panel for feature doors, wall art, or hotel lobby partitions.
